title: Cross-person, unseen-session Stroop condition inference from frontal fNIRS

evidence.supports: Preserved original source registration, source citations and proposed complete scientific endpoint; later implementation corrections are distinguished below.
Exact three-class participant-macro metric, fold declaration and complete prediction admission.
Source-audited field, indexing, author-protocol and trimming differences; native window bridge limitations.
All 165 metadata consumer, exact saved-period geometry and remaining identity/units holds.

evidence.locator: Methods and technical validation, as verified in preserved registration/source bridge
evidence.supports: 55-person three-session frontal fNIRS Stroop experiment and within-person author endpoint.
Fixed original source and authoritative recorded fields.
Inspected source-scope documentation distinguishing delivered software from authentic task execution.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human trial for this task is established by this source revision. Generated software checks are not participant performance.
excluded_claims: Historical binary 64% equals three-class benchmark performance
Cortical specificity from frontal fNIRS classification alone
Generated declarations certify authentic full-source completeness

disposition_reason: Complete 55-person three-class artifact scoring, native-window bridge and 165-report metadata consumer exist. Authentic candidate packets, verified export scale/timing, protected transport and competent references are not delivered. The author pooled-session binary result is not this held-person/session endpoint.

scientific_target.question: Can frontal HbO/HbR blocks identify neutral, congruent and incongruent Stroop conditions in unseen people on the globally withheld third-session schedule, beyond schedule and common-mode cues?
scientific_target.known_answer: Original block condition code 11/12/13, mapped to neutral/congruent/incongruent after authentic marker-to-prepared-array alignment.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Figshare 31839673 version 2 design_inf and nirsdata.vector_onset; agreement can be checked by bridge but the biological identity and actual timing join remain unqualified.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete onset-relative condition block; native bridge plans 640 by 70 values at nominal 25.6 Hz.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Participant, with blocks and three sessions nested; 55 source groups require verified biological-person mapping.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Three-class condition prediction conditional on this cohort and the observed third-session schedule; hemodynamic discrimination does not establish cortical conflict specificity.
exclusions: The published roughly 64% binary within-person result is not an acceptance threshold for this new three-class joint holdout.
No arbitrary unseen-schedule population claim from three schedules.
No assumption that Hb export values are micromolar concentrations.

inputs: 35 HbO then 35 HbR channels, relative times and authenticated channel geometry for every valid [-5,20) second block. Native arrays are time by 35 at nominal 25.6 Hz; proposed 40 by 70 serialization is not yet qualified.

Matched direct/tool/program conditions receive the same six training blocks, two per class, selected by a frozen training-only rule; full-training conditions use the other 44 persons sessions 1–2 and are separate.
forbidden_inputs: Condition markers, block indices, absolute clock, source filenames, session labels, chronology, word/ink/response and reaction time.
All held-person data and every person’s session 3 during fitting/tuning; cross-fold caches or case-adaptive test feedback.
observation_contract.case_identity: Bridge makes private HMAC case IDs from complete authenticated recording plans; no public authentic case manifest is supplied.
observation_contract.split: Implemented declaration: deterministic five folds of 11 people; each held group contributes session 3 only; train on the other 44 people sessions 1–2. Declaration checks do not enforce process isolation or actual training access.
observation_contract.coverage: All 55 people and 165 recording reports must be accounted for. Every authentic eligible third-session block is scored; no 30-block truncation. Saved-period exact-window metadata may have 639/640/641 samples, so clock normalization is a construction gate rather than silent resampling.

primary.name: Mean participant balanced accuracy across three conditions
primary.aggregation: Recall for each of three classes per person, then equal mean of all 55 people. Missing class/person is construction failure.
primary.rationale: Equal-person and equal-class weighting prevents dense blocks or prevalence from dominating condition discrimination.

secondary: Participant-macro log loss with 1e-15 true-class log floor; participant-macro Brier sum over three classes, range 0–2.
Each person and all five folds; same-case paired differences against competent baselines and nuisance-only models.

comparators.name: Training prior
comparators.procedure: Freeze three-class prevalence before held cases; chance is a mathematical control, not evidence of physiological information.

comparators.name: LDA/logistic/linear SVM
comparators.inputs: Identical canonical HbO/HbR representation and condition-matched training evidence
comparators.procedure: Proposed train-only fixed feature/time bins and nested participant tuning; calibrated SVM uses training folds only. No competent authentic baseline has run.

comparators.name: Schedule/common-mode/pre-onset controls
comparators.inputs: Training schedule descriptors or global-channel averages or pre-onset signals, each separated from the neural-only arm
comparators.procedure: Fit and freeze on sessions 1–2, then evaluate under the same held people/session schedule.

nuisance_controls: Session schedules repeat across people; suppress order/time clues and globally withhold session 3.
No short-separation channels: compare common-mode-only and spatial-pattern models, with fixed no-CAR sensitivity.
Verify trimming discrepancy (UsageNotes 15/15 seconds versus article 15/5), one-based markers, continuous filtering and previous-block carryover.
evaluation.uncertainty: Proposed paired participant bootstrap is descriptive conditional on fixed predictions, folds and observed schedule. Overlapping training sets and absent refitting prevent unconditional generalization confidence; scorer currently emits no interval.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exactly every committed opaque case with finite normalized three-class probabilities and consistent argmax label. Unknown/duplicate/missing cases, missing classes or incomplete 55-person census refuse the aggregate.

implementation.scorer_target: stroop.evaluate computes 55-person mean three-class balanced accuracy, Brier sum and clipped log loss from evaluator-supplied manifest labels. It does not infer labels from waveform or reproduce the author binary SVM.
implementation.delivered_scope: Scorer and declaration/bridge/metadata source cover complete logical cohort. Native array loading, participant-ready serialization and controlled solver execution are separate unfinished operations.
missing: Authentic biological identity/marker/trim/window alignment and physical export-scale validation.
Canonical 40-row anti-aliasing transform and matched complete candidate packets.
Competent train-only references, physiological controls, protected fresh state and uncertainty.
implementation.execution_evidence: Named source docs report generated interface controls and bounded archive inventory/source-script inspection. These are not authentic complete candidate execution or model performance.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed numeric 40 by 70 HbO/HbR case matrix plus same six demonstrations.
direct_observation.boundary: No numerical execution or feedback; fixed model/context and all channels/cases retained.
missing: Authenticated complete packet and capacity/quantization checks.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential complete HbO/HbR channel-time plots preserving units, polarity, scale and missingness.
typed_viewer.boundary: A viewer would need typed bounds and identical evidence; visual views are not currently provided.
missing: Renderer, action policy and protected answer capture.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed per-block numerical analysis of identical canonical arrays with condition-matched training decoders.
tool_assisted.boundary: Fresh state per case/fold, same permitted examples and declared compute; no session 3 fitting.
missing: Participant packet/transport and audited tool/data parity.

frozen_program.representation: Proposed predictor frozen with fitting recipe before held block access.
frozen_program.boundary: Train on selected fold/condition evidence only; scorer checks output, not actual program training custody.
missing: Executable lifecycle and authentic baseline qualification.

summary: Reconcile implemented 55-person artifact metric and metadata bridge with actual missing candidate transport.
Preserve author pseudo-trial/binary endpoint as context; explicitly distinguish the new held-person/session three-class task.
Keep units and saved-period versus nominal-grid geometry unresolved rather than asserting a fabricated canonical waveform.
revision.source_review: Reviewed preserved scientific registration and named implementation code/documentation; reused cited primary source evidence already verified in these records. No scientific arrays or evaluator labels were opened in this revision.
